description: Copies an 'Other contact' (from list_other_contacts) into the user's saved contacts — the only write that exists for Other contacts. copy_mask picks which fields carry over (names, emailAddresses, phoneNumbers; default all three). Returns the NEW saved person — use its resourceName ('people/c...') for further edits; the original otherContacts entry remains. Copying the same entry twice creates duplicate saved contacts. Requires BOTH the contacts and contacts.other.readonly OAuth scopes.

copy_mask.description: Fields to copy into the new saved contact (default all three).

read_mask.description: Person fields to return (default names, emailAddresses, phoneNumbers, organizations, memberships). Only masked fields come back — an absent field may be unmasked, not empty.

resource_name.description: The Other-contact's full resource name, e.g. "otherContacts/c123" — from list_other_contacts.

name: copy_other_contact
title: Copy an Other contact into My Contacts
